description: Events the server has received from SOLIDWORKS, oldest first, after a cursor: documents opened, saved, closed and changed, dialogs, and the outcomes of operations that were already answered timeout or dialog_open.

after_seq.description: Return events after this sequence number (the last_seq of an earlier answer); every kept event when absent.

kinds.description: Only these kinds, for example document.saved; every kind when absent.

limit.description: At most this many events, 1 to 1000; 100 when absent.
